Complete normal semantics and exact CI cross-package coverage pass. Full supported-platform CI remains required.

scope: Advisory fixed20-block affected P3 portfolio, all adverse observations retained. Independent bounded read-ahead and prompt-completion event using standard pipe; base already has bounded workers and buffers. No source sweep or reused timed prefix. No pooling with earlier immutable-copy events. Default host policy, not controlled release acceptance. Go managed/LLGo collector bytes differ, and Go counters exclude Rust/JIT allocation. Native-Go is an ordinary application control, not an optimized native lower bound.

mechanismDiagnostic.head: bc1a531daee4d39130a1dcded47080de150277dc
mechanismDiagnostic.scope: Separate counter-instrumented source archives and tests, never timed executables. All32 complete responses/role/compiler checked. Counts describe this fixed guest/payload/run, not universal values or a pure timing attribution; scheduler waits/scans depend on scheduling.
